svg.title: The ten phases and their gates
svg.desc: Phase 0, Reference: Old site runs locally. Everything inventoried, counts generated. Phase 1, Design system: Tokens match the theme on both sides of every breakpoint. Phase 1b, Proof: Five risky assumptions settled on real content before scaling up. Phase 2, Import: Counts equal. A rerun changes nothing. Every asset resolves. Phase 3, Components: Each block sits within a few pixels of the reference. Phase 4, Pages: Every URL resolves and section order is checked by script. Phase 5, Behaviour: Checklist ticked in Chromium, Safari, iOS. Console clean. Phase 6, Redirects: Checker fails its fixture, then passes staging at 0 failures. Phase 7, Verification: Twelve checks at zero. Every difference listed with its reason. Phase 8, Cutover: Live checks pass, with the owner. Old host retired after 30 days.
